summary.zh: 设计跨语言的错误传播与降级策略
summary.en: Design error propagation and graceful degradation

description.zh: 对比异常、Result 类型、错误包装与重试等做法，给出 API 边界和降级策略的建议。适合在新增接口、统一错误规范或提升服务健壮性时使用。
description.en: Compare exceptions, Result types, error wrapping, and retries, with advice on API boundaries and graceful degradation. Useful when adding endpoints, unifying error conventions, or improving resilience.
